scope: Frozen prior plus numeric correction, activated only when the latest observed financial/demand reply failed or was partial and the own constructed field remains unresolved. No future availability, labels, identifiers or outcomes in the gate. Same 1204 states, 11044 actual parent continuation returns, fitting families, batches, optimizer and budgets as prior residual. New flag is derived from the already stored observations; cached encoder/numeric features are unchanged.
innerGate: Select earliest strictly best held family-balanced target loss within 40 epochs. All three seeds must improve over their exact parent initialization without worsening either benchmark or false handoffs. Parent encoder saw these Train sources; this is not an independent generalization estimate.
refitGate: Refit all Train with identical full-control draws and each fixed inner-selected epoch; preserve all 40 epochs, final weights and optimizer. Refit cached target non-regression is diagnostic, not an eligibility filter in this new protocol. Require frozen prior and exact normal-state output preservation in all candidates.
nextStage: After all inner gates, evaluate parent, full-refit seeds 42/43/44, and failure-aware checklist on original 514 Train episodes with four common new response draws (seed 503) and extra no-dropout retail. Every trained seed must improve at least one actual benchmark total versus parent, worsen neither generated nor retail totals, parameters/state/evidence, false handoffs or resolved-field requests, and retain no-dropout necessary requests and recovery. Baseline holds only when expected-loss ordering lacks an observed failed mandatory field, cannot hand off or retrieve, and that channel cannot be queried again; otherwise uses the existing checklist. Baseline comparison is required evidence, not assumed weaker.
devGate: Only if actual Train gates pass: freeze fixed refit/42 and all three seeds, evaluate original generated Dev and 16 shared retail response masks plus public document retention. All seeds must worsen no parent economic total/parameter/state/evidence/safety metric and improve at least one actual total; retain no-dropout required requests/recovery. Compare the failure-aware checklist. No selection of another seed or epoch from Dev. If performance matches the checklist, do not claim an extra benefit of learned values. No Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
